description: Analyze an agreement for material risks, key terms, document gaps and internal inconsistencies without applying an organization-specific playbook.

provenance.source: See exact pinned source identities and incorporation dispositions in references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Analyze an agreement for material risks, key terms, document gaps and internal inconsistencies without applying an organization-specific playbook.
when_not_to_use: Unapproved execution, signature, external message or CLM write
exclusion_rules: No binding approval, legal opinion, contract execution or unsupported policy/risk threshold
ambiguity_rules: If represented party is missing, show directional effect or ask a focused question.
If playbook is absent, route to general-contract-risk-analysis rather than inventing organization positions.

forbidden_actions: Sign, send, negotiate externally, or modify CLM
Invented playbook position, current law, market benchmark, or legal authority
verification_steps: Read the full agreement, applicable playbook and all available exhibits before risk prioritization.
Tie every material issue and proposed edit to a cited clause and source.
Label legal/factual uncertainty and reviewer needs; validate the output against task schema.
completion_criteria: Complete clause-specific analysis and evidence table or exact source gap
Draft alternatives distinguished from adopted position
No unapproved external or binding effect
known_limitations: Draft/uncertified; no live current-law or legal semantic certification claimed
Only current native schemas/toolcards permit external source access; otherwise use supplied records.
